title: Demo De-activation
contents_preview: Demo Update I will be de-activating the Settler's Domain demo on August 14! That will be 1 week before the full release. If you want to try the demo, now's your time!! :D

title: Release Date Update!
contents_preview: Settler's Domain is now releasing on August 21! I realized that the 25th is opening night for gamescom, so it's probably not the best day to release. But hey, now you get the game 4 days earlier!! Woohoo!

title: Release Date Announcement!
contents_preview: After almost two years of development, Settler's Domain finally has a release date! On August 25, 2026, I'll be excited to share it with everyone!Check out the release date trailer:Mark your calendars! It'll be the best Tuesday you've had in a while.-rick
